description.fun: Cleffa turns up where meteors have landed, and on nights full of shooting stars groups of them dance until dawn, a sight said to bring good luck to anyone who sees it. That and its star-shaped silhouette have many believing it came down on a shooting star. Its Japanese name, Py, is just two kana long, tied for the shortest of any Pokémon.
description.guide: A small, pink, star-shaped Fairy baby Pokémon introduced in Generation 2. It is found where meteors have fallen and is said to arrive on shooting stars, dancing on nights when they fall. It evolves into Clefairy with high friendship.
description.tagline: A star-shaped baby that dances under shooting stars

description.fun: Shy Clefairy rarely let people see them, but on full-moon nights they come down from the mountains to dance in the moonlight, filling the air around them with a strange magnetic field. Its little wings can't carry it far, but they store moonlight and let it float. It's so well loved that the Poké Doll item is a Clefairy doll; in Japanese it's literally the 'Pippi Doll'.
description.guide: A pink, star-shaped Fairy Pokémon with small wings that store moonlight and let it float. It is shy and lives in the mountains, coming out to dance under the full moon, and some believe it came from space. It evolves into Clefable with a Moon Stone.
description.tagline: A shy moon dancer you'll only spot on full-moon nights

description.fun: One of the world's rarest Pokémon, timid Clefable flees as soon as it hears people, and its ears can pick up a pin drop up to a kilometre away. Some scientists think it gazes at the moon because it's homesick for its kind up there. Collectors know it too: Jungle's Clefable was the very first prerelease card in the Trading Card Game.
description.guide: The final stage of Cleffa's line, a tall, pink Fairy Pokémon that is timid, nocturnal and one of the rarest Pokémon. Its extremely sensitive ears let it hear sounds from far away, so it lives in quiet mountains. Clefable can Mega Evolve into Mega Clefable.
description.tagline: A rare, moon-gazing fairy with ears that hear a pin drop

description.fun: Grows large, butterfly-like wings and a beret-like curl, with sparkles always drifting around it. It doesn't fly with those wings: it uses moonlight to control gravity within 10 metres of itself and simply floats.

note.text: Cleffa is a baby Pokémon, added in Generation 2, a generation after the Clefairy it grows into.
